title: Feasible-only evaluation reveals useful reasoning hidden by invalid-action selection
decision: Report both full-catalogue and explicitly candidate-privileged feasible-only evaluation, while retaining the full catalogue as the headline interface.
plain_summary: The repaired JEPA still chooses many invalid actions from the full catalogue, but the same checkpoints solve up to 87.5% of ProofWriter and 50% of PlanBench validation episodes when the symbolic executor exposes only currently feasible actions.
